description: Successor to nz-rulespec-2026-10-20, replacing only nz/statute/2026-10-20-rulespec-nz-pco with nz/statute/2026-10-23-rulespec-nz-pco. The retained official XML and all provision bodies of the Social Security (Jobseeker Support and Accommodation Supplement) Amendment Act 2026 are unchanged; the successor adds reviewed amendment targets and commencement metadata derived from the XML Parts for encoding dated principal-Act rules. Every other scope is unchanged. It is a publish-only pin release for rulespec-nz; do not activate it.
name: nz-rulespec-2026-10-23-amendment-markers
